verse: “The time is fulfilled,” He said, “and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!”
story: John has just been arrested, and in that dark moment Jesus walks into Galilee with the first words of His public ministry.

He announces that the waiting is over. The time the prophets looked toward has reached its fullness, and God's reign has come near because the King Himself is standing among them. The word Mark uses for gospel means good news, an announcement of something already done. So Jesus asks for two things that belong together: turn around, and trust. Repentance is not a toll paid before the good news; it is the right response to it, a whole life turning toward God and resting on His promise in Christ.
Lent is a season for that same turning. The kingdom is near to you this morning; turn toward the King and believe Him.
theme: Lent: repentance, the road to the cross
